research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01: official frozen occupations, NLC appointment and historical annual report, Tiwi annual report, Menzies patron biography, NT library biography, parliamentary personal explanation, ANU event and AMSANT/Tiwi indexed reports searched. Targeted full-time and Red Cross/Research Council searches did not establish personal hours or settle all employment identities.

Three frozen occupation entries require explicit reconciliation: NLC beganApril2019 rather than2018; Tiwi employment continued into2019 rather than ending2018; Australian Research Council attribution conflicts with independently corroborated Red Cross work. Shared frozen roster unchanged.

Follow-up: obtain historic Wurli and Katherine West annual reports and executive/governance appointments; identify Batchelor/Nguiu/NLC early dates and health-department legal employers; confirm Red Cross title and dates, Tiwi cessation and individual hours, NLC duties-to-resignation leave, board remuneration and overlaps. No source establishes a complete paid full-time chronology.

Missing dates/hours are unknown, not zero. Do not add overlapping health, governance, political or study roles. Personal biography total23years is not a calculable dated full-time interval. Review government control of early undated institutional roles separately from current status.

Recovered source errors: Menzies HTML Unicode decoding error but PDF accessible; AMSANT PDF Internal Error; Tiwi Partners newsletter404. Primary indexed details retained with access limitations. No job-wide blocking error.

Follow-up2026-10-02: contemporaneous Red Cross appointment reproduced inOctober2012Tiwi Times establishes national-head title and2012commencement, materially clarifying the frozen Research Council conflict. Exact termination and whether any separateResearchCouncilrole existed remain unresolved; no duplicate public years.

Employer historical report index adds1997Katherine West engagement observation; Red Cross biography names trial executive officer. KWHBfullreportweb400size20198058; only index used. Next useful records: Red Cross2012–14staff departures, Wurli2013–15appointment announcement, Katherine West1997–2001executive contract and payroll, Tiwi2019separation and NLCJuly2021leave evidence. No individual full-time proof found.
